digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge and canary CI workflows
propositions: Bridge reconciler cron backstop must be changed from 20-minute uniform cadence to 40-minute uniform cadence using three cron entries over a 2-hour cycle to halve CI runner pool contention

Chain re-dispatch step must sleep for the pass's own elapsed duration (capped at 900 seconds, skipped above 1800 seconds) before issuing the next dispatch to double the inter-invocation period without requiring a new repo variable
Canary schedule must be changed from hourly (0 * * * *) to 2-hourly (0 */2 * * *) and its alert window doubled from 2 hours to 4 hours to maintain 3x cadence margin
All cadence-related comments, documentation, and test fixtures must be updated to reflect the 40-minute bridge period and 2-hourly canary period instead of 20-minute and hourly references
Jenkinsfile must mirror the 40-minute backstop cadence using a three-entry cron expression to maintain parity across CI providers

Test suite must verify that the three cron entries fire uniformly at 40-minute intervals, pacing sleeps correctly or skips per conditions, and re-dispatch occurs only when PASS_STARTED_EPOCH is set and numeric
